card.name: The word more or even as intensifier
card.fires_on: The words "more" and "even" (also "so" in "more so") used as comparative or emphasis words after a verb or adjective in general web prose, just before a comparison or a surprising extreme.

modes.label: Comparative "more"
modes.description: "more" after a verb like are, looks or done, leading into "like" or "than".
modes.example: The paintings are<< more>> like drawings with the black and terrac

modes.label: Emphasis "even"
modes.description: "even" marking a surprising extreme or an added item.
modes.example: this temple is older than "Pasargad" castle or<< even>> "Perspolice"

card.writes: It promotes "even" and similar emphasis words, so it pushes the next word toward an intensified or extreme claim.
card.plain: It fires on little words like "more" and "even" that set up a comparison or stress something surprising.
